title: Per Observation Loss
source_docs: Statistics and Machine Learning Toolbox/Incremental Learning/Drift Detection/Per_Observation_Loss.md
text: Per observation regression or classification error of incremental model, 3 inputs, 2 outputs, direct feedthrough, {Loss data type} sets Data type of loss output; {Select initial machine learning model} sets the initial incremental learning, {Loss function}, {Predictor data observation dimension} sets the observation dimension of predictor data, {Sample time (–1 for inherited)} sets the option to specify sample, {Integer rounding mode} sets the rounding mode for fixed-point operations, {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the method of overflow action, {Lock output data type setting against changes by the fixed-point tools} sets the prevention of fixed-point tools from overriding data, {Loss data type Minimum} sets the minimum value of loss output for range checking, {Loss data type Maximum} sets the maximum value of loss output for range checking, {Predict response data type} sets the data type of predict response Inherit, {Predict response data type Minimum} sets the minimum value of predict response for range checking, {Predict response data type Maximum} sets the maximum value of predict response for range checking, {Additional predict data type}, {Additional predict data type Minimum} sets the minimum value of additional predict for range checking, {Additional predict data type Maximum} sets the maximum value of additional predict for range checking, {Linear sum data type} sets the data type of linear sum, {Linear sum data type Minimum} sets the minimum value of linear sum for range checking and {Linear sum data type Maximum} sets the maximum value of linear sum for range checking. Values come from the instance.
